note: The Node that ships inside the Windows and Linux apps. 24 is what the runner is tested on (engines >=24) and the CI jobs use. Checksums are from https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.2/SHASUMS256.txt: x64 and arm64 are the Windows zips (installer/fetch-node.ps1), linux-x64 and linux-arm64 the .tar.xz files (installer/linux/stage.mjs). To move to another Node: change the version, replace all four hashes from that release's SHASUMS256.txt, and fetch it again for each architecture.
